item.title: Unlock Immediate Diagonal Scrolling with CSS scroll-axis-lock: none
item.description: When you scroll a 2D scroller on a website, the browser does a lot of work behind the scenes to keep you on track. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: also taken a look at scroll-axis-lock
item.description: Go off the scroll rails with one CSS property (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Improved CSS Text-Stroke
item.description: Arriving late to the party for this fun little CSS trick (with a few gotchas). (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Dark Mode Toggles: Two States are Enough
item.description: Yes, the underlying model must have three states, but one is always irrelevant to the actual user goal. Users do not seek out solutions to problems they don’t currently have. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Your SPA is Leaking Memory: 'Soak Test' It
item.description: Some teams force-reload their single-page web apps (SPAs) every few hours just to clear the memory the app leaked. A frontend soak test finds the leak instead. (1 source: frontendfocus)
